name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_battle_ prefix (battle-core table family), domain descriptor summon_minor_anim, and alternating_blit_toggle reflects both purpose and data type (an unsigned 8-bit boolean toggle). No Ghidra address residue (no _540fb / hex suffix). Accurately describes the value (cleared to 0 at INIT, XOR-flipped each tick so sprite 0 blits every other tick in states 1/7).
purpose: Alternating-blit toggle for the single-sprite minor summon-spell animation: gates the every-other-tick sprite-0 blit in flicker states 1/7.
logic_summary: Owned solely by fd2_tick_summon_spell_minor_animation_state (@0x275D6). INIT state 0 clears it to 0 (MOV byte ptr [0x540FB],0x0 @0x275E9) before any read. In states 1/7: read (CMP byte ptr [0x540FB],0x0 @0x27617; MOVZX @0x2762A) -- when 0 the sprite (frame index 0) is blitted -- then XOR-flipped (XOR byte ptr [0x540FB],0x1 @0x2763E), so blitting happens only every other tick. Value stays 0/1.
element_semantics: Single unsigned 8-bit boolean toggle (0/1). All accesses are byte-wide; every read is MOVZX (zero-extend). 0 = blit this tick, 1 = skip; flips each tick.
notes: src comment block (anisummn.c lines 1473-1488) already precise/accurate/ASCII and matches disasm addresses byte-for-byte (0x275E9 init clear, 0x27617 CMP read, 0x2762A MOVZX read, 0x2763E XOR flip) -> keep, no src edit. xrefs: only fd2_tick_summon_spell_minor_animation_state (WRITE @0x275E9, READ @0x27617, READ @0x2762A, READ_WRITE @0x2763E). is_const=false: game writes it (INIT clear + per-tick XOR), so mutable zero-bss runtime state. Ghidra data plate was empty (null) -> created concise plate via run_script_inline cu.setComment(CommentType.PLATE,...). On-disk image is 0x00.
